classification.difficultyReason: Deduce a right angle from two bearings, calculate horizontal distances and apply Pythagoras.

content.prompt:
Andrew ($A$) is on a bearing of $065^\circ$ from a building which is $150\text{ m}$ tall.

Bret ($B$) is on a bearing of $155^\circ$ from the same building.

The angle of elevation from Andrew to the top of the building is $42^\circ$ while the angle of elevation for Bret is $61^\circ$. The land surrounding the building is level.

How far apart are Andrew and Bret, to the nearest metre?
